name: Wager Races
description: Stakes on a race: virtual cash, or the pink slip itself. It owns stake escrow — both sides' stakes are taken through economy.currency before the flag, held, then paid or forfeited when world.raceFinished declares the order — so a wager can never be welched on and insufficient funds is rejected by the same ledger that prices parts. Pink-slip transfers move a vehicle between garage rosters; this component records the transfer intent and lets housing.garage_management execute it, because ownership rules ('not the car you are sitting in', slot caps) live there. Virtual currency only, by design and by tag — nothing here maps to real-money wagering. It does not own the race result (world.track_circuit owns laps and order), does not own matchmaking, and takes no house cut by default: the drama is the stake, not the rake.

inputs.name: allowPinkSlips
inputs.description: Whether vehicle-ownership stakes are offered. The genre's signature bet; disable for audiences where losing a car is too harsh a beat.

inputs.name: minStake
inputs.description: Floor on cash stakes. A non-trivial floor keeps wagers as events with ceremony instead of spammed coin flips.

inputs.name: maxStakeFraction
inputs.description: Largest stake as a fraction of the poorer party's balance. Caps the downside so one bad beat cannot end a campaign save.

inputs.name: houseCutFraction
inputs.description: Share of the pot skimmed per race. Zero by default; a sink only if the wider economy needs one, set deliberately and visibly.

outputs.name: activeWager
outputs.description: Current escrow: parties, stake type, amounts. Null between races. Read by the pre-race ceremony UI.

outputs.name: escrowHeld
outputs.description: Cash currently held in escrow, surfaced for audit and balance tooling.
